traditional: Vitality and authority combined with the body and daily needs.

modern.blend: Identity and emotion, the outer self and the inner life. How who you present yourself to be lines up (or doesn't) with what you actually feel and need.
modern.harmonious: Outer and inner self move easily together. Steady, consistent, at ease with oneself, though it can lack a charge of its own.
modern.hard: Ego needs and emotional needs pull from conflicting sources, so the public self and the private self work at cross purposes and have to be reconciled.
modern.business: Self-direction reads as either steady and integrated, or as internal conflict that undercuts decisiveness.

cyclicNote: This pair runs a full conjunction-to-conjunction cycle; waxing/waning phase meaning is carried on the transit entries.

provenance.cyclic: applied per-aspect on transit entries (cyclic model)
